run_ROPES_main: run the ROPES dataset preprocessing to generate 32-shot train dev and test splits
run_ROPES_more_shots: run the ROPES dataset preprocessing with varying shot counts from 64 to 4096
create_ROPES_dataset: create a ROPES dataset instance that loads reasoning over premises and evidence stories
review_map_hf_dataset_to_list: review the map_hf_dataset_to_list method that formats question situation and background into input output pairs
test_load_dataset: test the load_dataset method that fetches the ROPES dataset from HuggingFace
